statewideNote: Every Idaho voter decides these 4 Ballot Measures.

statewide.title: Only the Legislature could legalize marijuana and other drugs
statewide.yes: Only the Legislature could make marijuana or other drugs legal; citizens could no longer do it by petition.
statewide.no: Nothing changes: voters could still petition to put drug legalization on the ballot.
statewide.needs: a majority (rule not checked on an official page)

statewide.title: English as Idaho's official language, in the constitution
statewide.what: Amendment to Idaho Constitution - House Joint Resolution 6
statewide.yes: English becomes Idaho's official language in the constitution, and government business and public school lessons must be in English unless federal law says otherwise.
statewide.no: English stays the official language under state law only, and the constitution does not change.
statewide.needs: a majority (rule not checked on an official page)

statewide.title: Right to abortion before viability
statewide.yes: Abortion becomes a legal right in Idaho until viability, and after that in medical emergencies.
statewide.no: Idaho's current ban stays: abortion only to prevent death, or for reported rape or incest in the first trimester.
statewide.needs: a majority (rule not checked on an official page)

statewide.title: Pick an official state gun (advisory only)
statewide.yes: There is no yes or no. You choose one of six guns. The result is advice only.
statewide.no: This is not a yes-or-no question.
statewide.needs: a majority (rule not checked on an official page)
